conflicts_notes: Acts of 2024 c.77 resolves the legacy conflict: Treasurer and Tax Collector are appointed and their former elected positions are abolished. Current Planning Board roster supplies current membership.
Charter/current official roster limits direct-voter structure to Mayor, five at-large councilors, six district councilors, and six separately elected School Committee members.

Planning and Finance are appointed rather than direct-voter offices; Frontier representation is separated into one direct-voter seat and one local-school-appointed representative. Expired one-year 2025 offices are not stale-carried.

Planning Board is modeled at five seats per the annual report/current roster despite stale seven-seat boilerplate. Treasurer-Collector remains elected after the 2025 appointed-conversion ballot question failed.
Select Board doubles as Board of Health without a separate election. Current Housing Authority composition is normalized to three elected members plus tenant and Governor/state appointees.
